cells.note: Higher consistency corresponds to lower entropy, so the negative entropy correlation represents a positive association between consistency and ERP decoding accuracy.

O.outcome_detail: latency of peak high-alpha EEG decoding accuracy

cells.quote: Regarding decoding peak latency, we found a positive correlation between decoding peak latency and face recognition RT. Additionally, it was positively correlated with eye movement entropy and negatively correlated with non-verbal IQ, suggesting that the later the latency, the more inconsistent the eye movement behavior and the lower the IQ.
cells.note: Because higher consistency means lower entropy, the reported positive entropy–latency association indicates shorter peak-decoding latency for more consistent eye movements. Eye-movement consistency explained an additional 5.4% of latency variance after controlling for non-verbal IQ.
